description.value: Red Arrow Brewing Company is a craft brewery established in 2015 in the Cowichan Valley, operating out of a distinctive red-brick building that was originally an Arrow Custom Motorcycles showroom built in 1990. The taproom pours 12 beers on tap alongside craft cocktails and a full food menu, with a spacious family- and pet-friendly patio that features a Coast Salish totem carved by artist Tom Lafortune. It functions as a community hub in Duncan and welcomes reservations and brewery tours by arrangement.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms Red Arrow Brewing Company is an active craft brewery and full-service taproom at 5255 Chaster Road, Duncan BC V9L 5J2 — an address absent from OSM but clearly repeated across multiple website pages. The phone (250) 597-0037 matches the OSM record exactly. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, or water bottle refill appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields remain null; the website does confirm a full food menu, patio seating, and pet-friendly outdoor area.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established craft brewery and full-service taproom with a patio and food menu in Duncan — a natural and welcoming stop for touring cyclists exploring the Cowichan Valley.
